audit_item: M0.2 / installed-wheel workspace discovery on Linux
finding: Hosted PR CI run 39836917121 failed tests/test_research_access.py::test_registry_path_does_not_depend_on_output_or_cwd on Ubuntu. project_registry() assumed Path(__file__).parents[4] was the workspace root. Linux site-packages has lib/pythonX between the virtualenv and site-packages, so this selected the virtualenv directory. After correcting root discovery, run 39837931130 exposed a second cross-platform issue: the tracked legacy inventory blob was LF while its SHA marker had been computed from the Windows CRLF checkout bytes, so Linux correctly rejected the mismatched digest. A source audit also found the same fixed-depth assumption in WFO source hashing and the world-model CLI's Git/base-commit identity lookup.
change: Added ancestor-based workspace-root discovery using the workspace pyproject marker and reused it for the research registry and WFO source-tree identity. The world-model CLI uses the same marker-search behavior for its default repository identity root. Linux wheel-layout regressions change cwd to a temporary directory. The inventory and marker are marked -text in .gitattributes, normalized to tracked LF bytes, and the checksum binds those canonical bytes.
